description:
Look at you, bigshot, walking into a kitchen like it isn't some huge deal.

You see a fridge. You idly wonder how they came up with the name TextWorld for this place. It's pretty fitting. You make out a closed oven in the corner. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a table. You see a cookbook and a knife on the table. You make out a counter.
